meaning:
1) to neigh, cry shrilly
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to neigh (of men as stallions-fig.)
1a2) (Piel) to cry shrilly (in distress)

elsewhere.note: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple…
wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
